strikes.name: jab_fist
strikes.look: PROVISIONAL. The jab as a fist: a straight fist from the lead shoulder, the forearm plate behind it, the arm one line with the rear leg.
strikes.orig: PROVISIONAL: the jab as a fist: a straight fist from the lead shoulder, the forearm plate behind it

strikes.name: cross_fist
strikes.look: PROVISIONAL. The cross as a fist: the rear fist driven through the chest with the hips turned full, the lead forearm folded across the ribs.
strikes.orig: PROVISIONAL: the cross as a fist: the rear fist driven through the chest, the hips turned full

strikes.name: spear_fist
strikes.look: PROVISIONAL. The spear hand as a fist: a low straight fist from the crouch into the gut, the spine and the arm one long diagonal.
strikes.orig: PROVISIONAL: the spear hand as a fist: a low straight fist from the crouch into the gut

strikes.name: su_fist_unwind
strikes.look: PROVISIONAL. An unwinding fist: coiled with the fist carried across to the far shoulder, then the body opens out and the fist comes round level at the jaw; one turn, never two.
strikes.orig: PROVISIONAL: an unwinding fist: coiled with the fist carried across to the far shoulder, the body opening out so the fist comes round level at the jaw, the elbow leading the turn; one turn
